skills.description: Records repetitive actions, reviews generated scripts, assigns practical macros, and documents assumptions and limits.

skills.name: Apps Script Custom Function Developer
skills.description: Builds deterministic custom functions that transform inputs without relying on unsupported side effects.

skills.name: Spreadsheet Automation Developer

skills.name: Custom Menu and Sidebar Builder
skills.description: Creates menus, dialogs, and sidebars for guided spreadsheet workflows and user-friendly actions.

skills.name: Trigger Automation Engineer

skills.name: Email Automation Specialist

skills.name: Document Generation Automator

skills.name: Add-on Permission Auditor

skills.name: Extension Deployment Coordinator

skills.name: Third-Party Integration Designer

skills.name: Webhook and API Integration Specialist

skills.name: Integration Data Mapper

skills.name: Integration Failure Recovery Specialist

skills.name: Connector Cost and Quota Analyst

skills.name: Integration Documentation Builder

skills.name: Extension Offboarding Specialist

skills.name: KPI Definition Specialist

skills.name: Executive Dashboard Architect

skills.name: Operational Dashboard Designer

skills.name: Financial Reporting Builder

skills.name: Academic Performance Dashboard Designer

skills.name: Project Portfolio Dashboard Designer

skills.name: Report Refresh and Publication Manager

skills.name: Decision Memo Generator

skills.name: Dashboard Usability Tester

skills.name: Print Layout Specialist

skills.name: Page Break Designer

skills.name: Repeat Header Print Specialist

skills.name: HTML and Web Publication Specialist

skills.name: Cross-Format Quality Auditor

skills.name: Screen Reader Spreadsheet Designer

skills.name: Braille Support Coordinator

skills.name: Color Accessibility Specialist

skills.name: Keyboard-First Workflow Designer

skills.name: Accessible Chart and Dashboard Specialist

skills.name: Accessibility Audit Specialist

skills.name: Protected Range Architect

skills.name: Sheet Protection Specialist

skills.name: Sensitive Data Minimization Specialist

skills.name: De-Identification Specialist

skills.name: Formula and Hidden Data Leak Auditor

skills.name: Script and Add-on Risk Reviewer

skills.name: Retention and Disposal Planner

skills.name: Change Control Specialist

skills.name: Spreadsheet Governance Framework Designer
skills.description: Defines ownership, naming, access, documentation, review cadence, testing, incident response, and archival rules.

skills.name: Spreadsheet Test Case Designer

skills.name: Formula Reconciliation Specialist

skills.name: Broken Reference Repair Specialist

skills.name: Calculation Performance Analyst

skills.name: Large Workbook Optimizer

skills.name: Regression Test Specialist

skills.name: Data Lineage Auditor
skills.description: Maps source, transformations, formulas, pivots, charts, exports, and owners for traceable results.

skills.name: Workbook Health Report Builder

skills.name: Clean-State Verification Specialist

skills.name: Budget Template Designer

skills.name: Inventory Tracker Designer

skills.name: Attendance Tracker Designer

skills.name: Gradebook Designer

skills.name: Project Tracker Designer
skills.description: Builds task, owner, status, priority, start, due date, dependency, milestone, risk, and progress systems.

skills.name: CRM Lite Designer
skills.description: Creates contact, organization, opportunity, stage, owner, next action, activity, and pipeline summaries for small teams.

skills.name: Sales Tracker Designer
skills.description: Tracks transactions, products, customers, targets, commissions, returns, and period summaries.

skills.name: Schedule and Roster Designer
skills.description: Builds shifts, availability, assignments, conflict checks, hours, coverage, and printable schedules.

skills.name: Survey Analysis Template Designer
skills.description: Creates codebooks, cleaned responses, frequency tables, cross-tabs, charts, open-text coding, and summary views.

skills.name: Content Calendar Designer
skills.description: Builds channel, asset, owner, status, due date, publish date, campaign, links, approvals, and performance tracking.

skills.name: Workbook Architecture Planner

skills.name: Human-in-the-Loop Review Designer

Catalog Use Note Use these entries as a planning catalog. When turning an entry into an executable skill, define its trigger, inputs, outputs, dependencies, permissions, failure behavior, tests, and packaging rules. Combine entries only when they share a clear workflow, data model, or output type. Feature availability can vary by Google Workspace edition, browser, locale, administrator policy, data source, and staged rollout. Implemented skills should detect unavailable functions and provide a supported fallback rather than pretending the feature exists.
